children: CEO Keyvan Mohajer sold 137,290 Class A shares in a transaction valued at about $868,853, with the proceeds used to meet tax obligations tied to vested restricted stock units, according to a Sept. 17 regulatory filing.
The shares were sold Sept. 15 at an average price of $6.3286, the filing showed. Mohajer retained 3,684,947 Class A shares following the transaction.
The filing indicated that the sale was connected to restricted stock units granted from 2023 through 2026. It did not identify the transaction as a discretionary open-market sale.

SoundHound AI has continued to post rapid revenue growth while remaining unprofitable. The company reported second-quarter revenue of $61.9 million, up 45% from a year earlier, while its GAAP net loss narrowed to $42.8 million from $74.7 million.
Shares closed at $5.93 on Sept. 18 and have declined about 40% this year.

title: SoundHound AI CEO Sells Thousands of Shares After 40% Stock Crash
